media_work.title: The Case Against Adnan Syed
media_work.focus_or_theme: Re-examination of Adnan Syed case (post-"Serial"), new evidence, witness interviews, legal appeals, potential cultural bias.
media_work.summaryNotes: Followed Syed's case leading up to and after his 2022 release.

media_item.focus_or_theme: Re-examination of Adnan Syed case (post-"Serial"), new evidence, witness interviews, legal appeals, potential cultural bias.

research_notes_other.notes_from_film_list.txt: Directed by Amy Berg; Presents new evidence, interviews key witnesses not in "Serial" podcast; Examines impact of cultural/religious bias; Provides updates on legal battle. Available via HBO Max.
research_notes_other.research_findings: This HBO docuseries delves deeper into the evidence and appeals process following the "Serial" podcast. It includes access to Syed and his family, examines potential flaws in the state's case, and covers developments leading to his release in 2022. A follow-up episode covering events post-release is reportedly in production.

featured_individuals.crime_convicted_of_raw: Murder (of ex-girlfriend Hae Min Lee in 1999)
contributing_factors_raw: Questions about effectiveness of original defense counsel, reliability of cell tower data, potential withheld evidence (alternative suspects), possible cultural/religious bias.
featured_individuals.status_raw: Complex; Currently free pending further appeals after conviction was vacated then reinstated on procedural grounds (as of early 2024 reporting).
organizations_involved_raw: University of Baltimore Innocence Project Clinic; Support from advocates like Rabia Chaudry.
